prose: The Wall Street Journal reports, per Techmeme, that US professional services added 70K jobs in October, the most since July 2022, as AI-exposed consulting and legal roles grew. Basis: paywalled; only the headline is known.
highlights: 70K professional services jobs added in October, most since July 2022.
AI-exposed fields such as consulting and legal grew.
basis: Paywalled or unreadable source; written from headline only.
